segments.an7.58:1.1: “Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni, tīhi ca anupavajjo.
segments.an7.58:1.4: natthi tathāgatassa kāyaduccaritaṃ yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya –
segments.an7.58:2.2: natthi tathāgatassa vacīduccaritaṃ yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya –
segments.an7.58:3.2: natthi tathāgatassa manoduccaritaṃ yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya –
segments.an7.58:4.2: natthi tathāgatassa micchāājīvo yaṃ tathāgato rakkheyya –
segments.an7.58:6.3: Tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati –
segments.an7.58:6.6: Etamahaṃ [etaṃpahaṃ (sī. syā.)], bhikkhave, nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
segments.an7.58:7.1: “Supaññattā kho pana me, bhikkhave, sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā.
segments.an7.58:7.2: Yathāpaṭipannā mama sāvakā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
segments.an7.58:7.3: Tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati –
segments.an7.58:7.4: ‘itipi te na supaññattā sāvakānaṃ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā. Yathāpaṭipannā tava sāvakā āsavānaṃ khayā … pe … sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī’ti.
segments.an7.58:7.6: Etamahaṃ, bhikkhave, nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
segments.an7.58:8.1: “Anekasatā kho pana me, bhikkhave, sāvakaparisā āsavānaṃ khayā … pe … sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
segments.an7.58:8.2: Tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessati –
segments.an7.58:8.3: ‘itipi te na anekasatā sāvakaparisā āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī’ti.
segments.an7.58:8.5: Etamahaṃ, bhikkhave, nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
segments.an7.58:10.1: “Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni, imehi ca tīhi anupavajjo”ti.

lines: Ayañhi attanā desitadhamme ekapadampi durakkhātaṃ aniyyānikaṃ apassanto dhammanimittaṃ na samanupassati,“durakkhāto tayā dhammo na svākkhāto”ti uṭṭhahitvā paṭippharantaṃ ekaṃ puggalampi apassanto puggalanimittaṃ na samanupassati nāma.
Thaddhamacchariyasadisaṃ hi kucchitaṃ sabbanihīnaṃ natthi sabbakusalānaṃ ādibhūtassa nisedhanato.
